title: The guard refuses a git write joined by ';' after a cd
why: Runner 9's incident at 16:15 CST Nov 7: a git write ran after a cd joined by ';'. If the cd fails, the write still runs, in the wrong checkout.
note: Also checks whether the merge tool removed runner 9's scratch worktree. Done check: the ';' form is red on main and refused; the '&&' form still passes. The guard's verdict changes, so this is a build lane.
